gaps: No complete FCV pathway is assembled from coastal exposure or programme targeting of at-risk youth.
Named road/beach examples and regional indicators do not provide complete district-by-group vulnerability or resilience-effect estimates.

executive_assessment.text: Named road and beach examples distinguish Mahé, Praslin and La Digue exposure, including Bel Ombre, Port Glaud, Au Cap, L'Amitié Road, Anse Kerlan and Anse Royale.
Health-service and mobility-related social-protection gaps identify differentiated vulnerability; modeled rainfall and tuna-distribution hypotheses remain distinct from observed impacts.
Early-warning equipment, institutional restructuring and programme objectives are inputs or intentions, not demonstrated resilience, inclusion or peace outcomes.
